prompt:
Goal: Create a polished square promotional anime key visual for GPT Image 2.5, presenting it as a futuristic creative image-generation service with a cheerful anime ambassador reaching toward the viewer.

Canvas: 1:1 square social-media poster, cinematic neon city background at sunset, high-detail anime illustration blended with sleek SaaS launch-page UI overlays. Use strong depth of field: the character’s outstretched hand is large and slightly motion-blurred in the foreground, her face is sharp, and the city is softly glowing behind her.

Main subject: A cute anime girl in the center-right foreground, about teenage/young adult style, short fluffy pale pink-blonde bob hair with bangs, one eye winking and one warm reddish-brown eye open, smiling brightly. She wears a futuristic black-and-white techwear jacket with glossy panels, straps, zippers, badges, red ribbon accents, black inner top, and a lanyard badge printed with the OpenAI-like knot logo and “GPT Image 2.5”. Her right arm reaches toward the camera invitingly. Add a small black-and-red hair clip and ribbon on one side.

Companion robot: Place exactly 1 small rounded companion robot at the lower right, white body with cat-ear-like points, glossy black face screen, cyan smiling eyes, and a chest panel containing the OpenAI-like knot logo plus the text “Create Explore Together”.

Branding and headline: At the upper left, place a large glowing OpenAI-like knot icon followed by huge text “GPT” on the first line and “Image 2.5” below it, with “2.5” in a blue-to-pink neon gradient. Under it, add the tagline “More Expressive. More Creative. Now in Your Hands.” Add handwritten Japanese text beneath: 「想像を、もっと自由に。」

Left feature stack: Add exactly 6 translucent dark glassmorphism cards stacked vertically on the left, each with a glowing icon, bold white title, smaller subtitle, and where visible a small preview thumbnail strip. The 6 cards are: 1) “Text to Image” with subtitle “Just type your imagination” and 1 landscape castle thumbnail; 2) “Sketch to Image” with subtitle “Turn your sketches into art” and 2 thumbnails showing a sketch converting to a fantasy landscape with an arrow; 3) “Image Editing” with subtitle “Refine with simple instructions” and 2 anime portrait thumbnails with an arrow; 4) “In-context Creation” with subtitle “Consistent characters & style” and 2 anime character thumbnails; 5) “Faster Generation” with subtitle “Create more, wait less” and a lightning icon; 6) “Higher Detail” with subtitle “Sharper, richer, more real” and 1 flower thumbnail.

Right feature stack: Add exactly 3 translucent dark glassmorphism cards on the right side. The top card is “Multi-style” with subtitle “Anime, Realistic, Illustration...” and exactly 3 thumbnails: anime portrait, realistic landscape, cat photo. The middle card is “Follow Instructions” with subtitle “More accurate, more flexible”. The lower card is “Create on Mobile” with subtitle “@ → Sketch (iOS/Android)”.

Handwritten notes: In the upper right sky, add Japanese handwritten copy: 「好きな世界を、今すぐ、ここから。」 followed by a signature Chisato and a heart. At the bottom right, add handwritten Japanese copy: 「つくろう。あなたの『好き』を。」 and the line “with GPT Image 2.5”. At the bottom left, add a small OpenAI-like knot icon and cursive English text “A more creative tomorrow_”.

Visual style: Premium anime promotional art, vibrant blue, cyan, magenta, and sunset-pink lighting; glowing holographic UI panels; reflective metal and glass; crisp typography; dramatic wide-angle selfie perspective; highly detailed face and clothing; soft bloom, rim light, and lens flare. Keep all UI text legible and aligned, with no extra feature cards beyond the specified counts.

promptZh:
目标：为 GPT Image 2.5 创作一张精美的方形动漫宣传主视觉图，将其呈现为一种充满未来感的创意图像生成服务，并由一位亲切的动漫大使向观众伸出手。

画布：1:1 方形社交媒体海报，背景为日落时分的电影感霓虹城市，将高细节动漫插画与流畅的 SaaS 发布页面 UI 叠加层融合。使用强景深效果：角色伸出的手在前景中较大且略带动态模糊，面部清晰，城市在身后柔和发光。

主体：前景中右侧是一位可爱的动漫少女，青少年/年轻成人风格，短而蓬松的 浅粉金色 波波头，留着刘海，一只眼睛眨眼，另一只红棕色的眼睛睁开，笑容灿烂。她穿着一件带有光泽面板、绑带、拉链、徽章和红色丝带装饰的未来感黑白机能风夹克，内搭黑色上衣，挂绳徽章上印有类似 OpenAI 的结状 Logo 和“GPT Image 2.5”。她的右臂向镜头伸出，姿态邀请。在一侧添加一个小型的黑红色发夹和丝带。

机器人伙伴：在右下角放置 1 个圆润的小型机器人伙伴，白色身体，带有类似猫耳的尖角，黑色光泽面部屏幕，青色笑眼，胸部面板包含类似 OpenAI 的结状 Logo 以及文字“Create Explore Together”。

品牌与标题：在左上角放置一个巨大的发光 OpenAI 风格结状图标，下方第一行是大号文字“GPT”，第二行是“Image 2.5”，其中“2.5”采用蓝到粉的霓虹渐变色。下方添加标语“More Expressive. More Creative. Now in Your Hands.”。在下方添加手写日语文字：「想像を、もっと自由に。」

左侧功能堆栈：在左侧垂直堆叠 6 张半透明的深色磨砂玻璃质感卡片，每张卡片带有发光图标、加粗的白色标题、较小的副标题，并在可见处附带小型预览缩略图条。6 张卡片分别为：1) “Text to Image”，副标题“Just type your imagination”，配 1 张风景城堡缩略图；2) “Sketch to Image”，副标题“Turn your sketches into art”，配 2 张展示草图转换为奇幻风景及箭头的缩略图；3) “Image Editing”，副标题“Refine with simple instructions”，配 2 张带箭头的动漫肖像缩略图；4) “In-context Creation”，副标题“Consistent characters & style”，配 2 张动漫角色缩略图；5) “Faster Generation”，副标题“Create more, wait less”，配闪电图标；6) “Higher Detail”，副标题“Sharper, richer, more real”，配 1 张花朵缩略图。

右侧功能堆栈：在右侧添加 3 张半透明的深色磨砂玻璃质感卡片。顶部卡片为“Multi-style”，副标题“Anime, Realistic, Illustration...”，配 3 张缩略图：动漫肖像、写实风景、猫咪照片。中间卡片为“Follow Instructions”，副标题“More accurate, more flexible”。底部卡片为“Create on Mobile”，副标题“@ → Sketch (iOS/Android)”。

手写笔记：在右上角天空处，添加日语手写文案：「好きな世界を、今すぐ、ここから。」，后跟签名 Chisato 和一颗心。在右下角，添加日语手写文案：「つくろう。あなたの『好き』を。」以及一行“with GPT Image 2.5”。在左下角，添加一个小型的 OpenAI 风格结状图标和草书英文“A more creative tomorrow_”。

视觉风格：高级动漫宣传艺术，充满活力的蓝色、青色、洋红色和日落粉色灯光；发光的全息 UI 面板；反光的金属与玻璃；清晰的排版；戏剧性的广角自拍视角；高度精细的面部与服装；柔和的辉光、边缘光和镜头光晕。保持所有 UI 文字清晰且对齐，除指定数量外，不添加额外的功能卡片。
